title: System Metrics - Detailed (PromQL Updated)
description: Detailed live Linux host dashboard using node_exporter metrics already ingested into OpenObserve. Counter panels show cumulative values; use rate calculations for throughput trends if desired. Includes PromQL CPU utilization, memory/disk percentages, and network/disk rates.

panels.title: CPU Usage (%)
panels.description: CPU utilization excluding idle time; 5-minute rate.

queries.query: 100 * (1 - avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])))
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_load1" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_load5" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_load15" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_memory_memavailable_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_memory_memfree_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_memory_memtotal_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Filesystem available bytes
panels.description: Available bytes by filesystem and mountpoint

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_filesystem_avail_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Filesystem free bytes
panels.description: Free bytes by filesystem and mountpoint

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_filesystem_free_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_filesystem_size_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_disk_read_bytes_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_disk_written_bytes_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Disk I/O time
panels.description: Cumulative time spent doing disk I/O

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_disk_io_time_seconds_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_network_receive_bytes_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_network_transmit_bytes_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_network_receive_errs_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_network_transmit_errs_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_context_switches_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_intr_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_filefd_allocated" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_filefd_maximum" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_boot_time_seconds" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_procs_running" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "node_procs_blocked" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Exporter scrape status
panels.description: Exporter scrape health; 1 means target is up

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "up" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Memory Usage (%)
panels.description: Used memory percentage calculated from MemAvailable and MemTotal.

queries.query: 100 * (1 - node_memory_memavailable_bytes / node_memory_memtotal_bytes)

panels.title: Root Disk Usage (%)
panels.description: Used space percentage for root filesystem.

queries.query: 100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/",fstype!~"tmpfs|overlay"})

panels.title: Network Receive (bytes/sec)
panels.description: 5-minute rate of received network bytes, excluding loopback.

queries.query: rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device!="lo"}[5m])

panels.title: Network Transmit (bytes/sec)
panels.description: 5-minute rate of transmitted network bytes, excluding loopback.

queries.query: rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device!="lo"}[5m])
rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total[5m])
rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total[5m])
node_memory_memavailable_bytes / 1073741824
